data.name: Temple of the Green Moon: Prologue
data.detailed_description:
You're alone. Darkness and hopelessness surround you. These creatures are everywhere. Can you save yourself, or is it all doomed?

As a tourist, Alyona, you find yourself deep in the caves of the Zhigulyov Mountains. Use a flashlight to scare away monsters. Your only goal is to find a way out and escape!

EXPECTATIONS = REALITY:

  • Fights with mysterious creatures.

  • Parkour and survival elements.

  • First-person exploration of mysterious locations.

  • Uncomplicated yet exciting brainteasers.

Find out what brought Alyona to the caves and how her fate will turn out. Follow the path, plunge into the anomalous zone, and face the unknown!

Check out this free prologue to the game "Temple of the Green Moon", in which you will embark on an exciting adventure as Alena, a tourist! Unlike the main game, the prologue only allows you to explore one location, try out the basic mechanics, and play as a different character. (this is not the main game)
